findings.evidence: Diff renames `TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/Generator.lean` to `TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/Generator/Basic.lean`; `find code/TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups -maxdepth 3 -type f` shows `Generator/Basic.lean` and `Generator/Invariance.lean` but no `Generator.lean`, while prior public imports used `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.Generator`.
findings.fix: Restore `TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/Generator.lean` as a public re-export module, e.g. importing `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.Generator.Basic` and, if desired, `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.Generator.Invariance`.
findings.issue: Renaming the public module `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.Generator` to `TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.Generator.Basic` without a compatibility wrapper breaks downstream imports of the old public API path.

summary: The new invariance lemmas cover the roadmap API and are re-exported by the umbrella module, but the PR removes the existing public module path for the generator API.
